verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Champs-Elysees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hidden just steps from the Champs-Élysées, Hôtel de Berri invites guests into a world where artistry, history, and imagination converge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands on a historic Parisian address that was once home to couturiere Elsa Schiaparelli.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hôtel de Berri stands on a historic Parisian address once home to legendary couturière Elsa Schiaparelli.

verified_facts.text: Each room and suite was designed by Philippe Renaud and blends curated antiques, handcrafted textures and contemporary artworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Philippe Renaud, each room and suite blends curated antiques, handcrafted textures, and contemporary artworks with refined Parisian sophistication.

verified_facts.text: The room decor blends neoclassical elegance with surrealist details.
verified_facts.excerpt: the décor blends neoclassical elegance, surrealist details, curated antiques, and contemporary artworks

verified_facts.text: Many of the accommodations overlook the hotel's private garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: many overlooking the hotel’s peaceful private garden steps from the Champs-Élysées

verified_facts.text: The Parisian Suite is inspired by the residence of Elsa Schiaparelli.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the legendary residence of Elsa Schiaparelli, The Parisian Suite is Hôtel de Berri’s signature masterpiece.

verified_facts.text: The Parisian Suite has views over the private garden, a dining room for six, a salon, a marble bathroom and a walk-in dressing room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring panoramic views over the hotel’s private garden, a dining room for six, a spacious salon, marble bathroom, and walk-in dressing room

verified_facts.text: Each suite has an Apple TV and a hi-fi speaker system.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each Suite comes equipped with all things tech, including Apple TV & HI FI Speaker System.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Toto toilets and heated Italian marble floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in luxury hotel rooms in Paris with Toto Toilets, heating Italian marble floors and mirrors.

verified_facts.text: The large suites are suited to families and guests who want more space.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our large suites are perfectly suited to families and those who want more space.

verified_facts.text: Le Schiap by Stephane Pitre pays tribute to Elsa Schiaparelli through refined French cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Schiap by Stéphane Pitré pays tribute to Elsa Schiaparelli through refined French cuisine, creativity, and Parisian art de vivre.

verified_facts.text: At Le Bizzaz, guests can sip teas in large armchairs, and the cocktails and wine list take center stage as night approaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large armchairs invite you to sit down and enjoy the lush surroundings, while sipping a sharp selection of teas. As nighttime approaches, the cocktails and wine list take center stage.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located steps from the Golden Triangle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located steps from the Champs-Élysées and Paris’s iconic Golden Triangle

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge team arranges private museum visits, curated shopping experiences and restaurant reservations.
verified_facts.excerpt: From private museum visits to curated shopping experiences and restaurant reservations, our Luxury Collection Concierge team is dedicated to creating unforgettable moments in the heart of Paris.

verified_facts.text: Guided tours of the hotel surroundings, curated by the Chief Concierge, let guests rediscover the Champs-Elysees area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Curated by our Chief Concierge, guided tours of the hotel surroundings will allow our guest to travel through time and re-discover the Champs-Elysées area.

verified_facts.text: Parc Monceau is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just a 10-minute walk from the hotel, le Parc Monceau was the whimsical fancy of the king’s cousin, The Duke of Chartres.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the Jacquemart-Andre museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel also offers close proximity to some of Paris' lesser-known museum, such as Jacquemart-André museum

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a gym with cardio and strength equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: We invite you to work out in our well-equipped hotel gym offering cardio and strength equipment.

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Hôtel de Berri Champs-Élysées, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Paris do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at Hôtel de Berri Champs-Élysées, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Paris do not permit rollaway beds.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with one pet allowed per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at Hôtel de Berri Champs-Élysées, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Paris. One pet is allowed per room

verified_facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24 Hour Room Service
